title: Monster Slider
native_title: モンスター・スライダー
overview:
The tilt changes!? An unprecedented falling-block game is born!!

Dracula has kidnapped Claudia, and her sister Nina takes up a holy cross to battle his monstrous minions and win her back.

Pairs of colored blocks drop into a well with a slanted floor, then slide downhill once they land. Touch three of the same color to clear them, and tilt the floor left or right with the L and R buttons at any moment to shift the blocks and set off long chain reactions. Chains bury your rival under skull blocks, and every character has a special ability triggered by clearing S blocks.

- Story Mode: play as Nina against Dracula and his minions
- Two-Player Mode with any character and separate difficulty settings
- Endless solo mode

傾きが変わる！？
空前の落ちゲー誕生！！
